thought_uid.Description: Stable within-subject identifier (t01..t09) for one of the nine idiographic thoughts. The same thought carries the same uid across all runs. Joins to the thought_uid column in *_events.tsv. The original participant-generated reminder text has been removed for privacy and is not distributed.

dyscontrol_raw.Description: Mean of quality_repetitive, quality_intrusive, and quality_uncontrollable. n/a if all three are missing.

dyscontrol_imputed.Description: As dyscontrol_raw but missing constituent items are imputed as 0 before averaging (principled floor: absence of endorsement). See accompanying manuscript for rationale.
